Messages.Author: DJ.Mik
Messages.Body:
Seeing all these Trujah Rush Decks, I just started wondering if
Clotho's gift can be stacked with Nu's ability to untap, making it
possible for him to untap twice per round.

Is there a ruling on this, and if not, what would a future ruling be ?

Kind Regards

DJ Mik

Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
"DJ.Mik" <djmi...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:81800800.02060...@posting.google.com...

> Seeing all these Trujah Rush Decks, I just started wondering if
> Clotho's gift can be stacked with Nu's ability to untap, making it
> possible for him to untap twice per round.

It's stackable. You can untap twice a round, paying one blood each time. Nu
can even play seven Clotho's gift to untap 8 times in a turn. Guess you have
to find 8 different interesting actions though =)

> Is there a ruling on this, and if not, what would a future ruling be ?

no.
